exposure: Nulliparous women attempting vaginal delivery with viable, singleton, vertex fetuses
outcome: Arrest of dilation at less than 6 cm
cohort: Nulliparous women attempting vaginal delivery with viable, singleton, vertex fetuses at a single academic center
finding: The cesarean delivery rate among nulliparous women attempting vaginal delivery was substantially reduced in association with decreased frequency in the diagnosis of arrest of dilation at less than 6 cm after adopting labor management guidelines.
mod_finding: The implementation of labor management guidelines led to a substantial reduction in the cesarean delivery rate among nulliparous women.
